major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Lead every burst window with it, since it raises damage and Critical Strike for 20s and empowers Judgment into Hammer of Wrath, so line stat trinkets and your potion up inside it and hold it while Algeth'ar Puzzle Box is under 5s from ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the cast id observed in the sampled parse; the guide links the 384376 passive and the APL references 454351.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it with Wake of Ashes under a GCD from ready and Avenging Wrath more than 15s out, only on targets living longer than 10s, and keep using your AoE abilities normally through its 10s window.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it once Execution Sentence has gone out or is more than 4s away and Avenging Wrath is more than 6s off, then spend the free Hammer of Light it grants immediately; overcapping Holy Power on the cast is acceptable.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it after Wake of Ashes when Avenging Wrath is more than 15s away, or when adds arrive within 10s, for Judgment on up to 5 targets.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it pre-pull when equipped, and in combat channel it while Avenging Wrath is coming up rather than after, since the 2s channel otherwise eats time inside the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket; the ability table lists spell 383781 under the truncated name 'Algeth'ar Puzzle'. talent_gated is set so builds without the trinket are not flagged for zero casts.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for 8s: save it for a lethal mechanic or to drop a stacking debuff, and remember it leaves Forbearance for 30s.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: 20% damage reduction for 8s on a 1 min cooldown, usable while stunned, so spend it on every predictable raid damage window rather than saving it.
defensives.id_note: 403876 is the Retribution cast id observed in the parse; 498 is the baseline Paladin version of the same button.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Physical immunity for 10s on yourself or an ally to survive a melee or bleed mechanic; it causes Forbearance, so it locks out Divine Shield and Lay on Hands.
defensives.id_note: Table row is name-verified but not pressed in the sampled parse; still a real castable ability.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency full heal for yourself or a dying ally when no external will land in time; causes Forbearance for 30s.

rules.description: Blade of Justice into Avenging Wrath opener
rules.action: Open Blade of Justice, Avenging Wrath, Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, the free Hammer of Light, two Final Verdicts, then Divine Toll, with Algeth'ar Puzzle Box channelled pre-pull.

rules.description: Hammer of Light after every Wake of Ashes
rules.action: Spend the free Hammer of Light that Wake of Ashes grants before any other button; it sits at the top of the priority in both single-target and AoE.

rules.description: Execution Sentence right before Wake of Ashes
rules.action: Cast Execution Sentence with Wake of Ashes under a GCD from ready so its 10s window absorbs that damage, and only with Avenging Wrath more than 15s out.

rules.description: Blade of Justice on every Art of War proc
rules.action: React to Art of War with Blade of Justice ahead of your spender; wasting 1 Holy Power is correct here so a second proc cannot overwrite Light Within.

rules.description: Judgment held at capped Holy Power
rules.action: Do not press Judgment at 5 Holy Power just to start its 11s cooldown; spend first, and check whether a generator will refill you within a GCD before topping up.

rules.description: Divine Storm on three or more targets
rules.action: Swap your spender to Divine Storm at 3 or more targets, or at 2 with Tempest of the Lightbringer and no Jurisdiction; on any target count an Empyrean Power proc makes it free.

source_summary: Retribution stacks its damage into Avenging Wrath: press it first, put stat trinkets, the potion and any instant on-use damage inside its 20s window, and channel Algeth'ar Puzzle Box before it rather than during. Execution Sentence goes out with Wake of Ashes under a GCD from ready so the sentence collects that damage, and Wake of Ashes is then followed immediately by the free Hammer of Light it grants. Outside cooldowns the loop is Holy Power efficiency: react to Art of War with Blade of Justice, avoid generating at 5 Holy Power, and switch the spender to Divine Storm at 3 or more targets.
